shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at −1 on the number line on the left with the mark at (4,−4) on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed set excludes −1 at its upper bound. Right image: The point belongs to the plotted graph and gives g(4)=−4.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow endpoint marks a strict boundary of the marked ray. On the right, the filled marker adds that coordinate pair to the graph and supplies the value at its horizontal coordinate.
